svg.aria-label: The 4,096 actions: the policy head scores 64 move types on each of 64 squares; 1,792 of these from-to pairs are possible moves; at the example position the legal mask leaves 44 and the network puts 0.25 on d4.

g.text: here d4; types that leave the board are dropped
From d4, 35 of the 64 stay on the board.
rows: from-square, columns: to-square (a1, b1, …, h8)
The network scores 64 move types on each of the 64
squares (a); a fixed table puts each on-board one
into its from–to cell. Grey cells never get a score.
44 legal moves of 4,096; softmax over them
